title: 70-year-old woman medevaced from cruise ship off Maui
description: A 70-year-old Australian woman arrived safely to Maui Memorial Medical Center after being medically evacuated from a cruise ship off Maui, Hawaii, April 3, 2018. An MH-65 Dolphin helicopter aircrew from Coast Guard Air Station Barbers Point, Oahu, hoisted the woman and safely transported her to Kahului Airport in Maui where local emergency medical services personnel were waiting. (U.S. Coast Guard video/Released)
